scenes.label: of food a wild Asian elephant eats every day
scenes.body: They spend about three-quarters of the day eating or moving toward food or water.

caption:
The daily menu of an Asian elephant is mostly... the daily menu.

Wild Asian elephants also drink about 189 litres (50 gallons) of water a day. The clips were filmed at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, Sri Lanka; the river shot is a wild elephant in Laos.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Snack-guilt meme that lands on a real number; captive orphanage clips carry only the joke, the wild stat sits over a wild photo, and the caption names the location so nothing is passed off as wild behaviour.
